semantic.justification: VM snapshot reconstruction is local infrastructure rather than an upstream native function or a browser environment API. This shard lowers the existing persisted scalar/Which representation into actual original item constructors in every realm. It stays beside SwAttrPool restore registration to separate transport reconstruction from the size-bounded core owner; it owns no model, service or native type substitute. Original paragraph control concrete values replace generic Writer split and signed16 line-count items. Split preserves false factory versus true Writer pool default; widow/orphan preserve unsigned8 storage, signed8 Any projection and zero global/two-line document overlays. Concrete copy/Clone and vertical signed16 QueryValue/0..4 PutValue use actual Sfx/Any owners. Actual pool, snapshot reconstruction, CSS/RTF producers and paragraph UI commands use the correct concrete values. DOCX emits original split/widow boolean normalization, script-space/hanging/forbidden/grid booleans, vertical mapping, page-break spelling and outline clamp through the real exporter/serializer and native ZIP output. No fake exporter, direction/version provider or complete main-text/paragraph/style orchestration is introduced. Localized EditResId GetPresentation, original instance managers, native allocator/physical ABI and full DOCX text/model/filter/UI acceptance remain unported or unqualified. Current keep/line-number snapshot factories retain their existing separately bounded scalar domains; no full item-pool parity is claimed. Keeps primitive color reconstruction in the adjoining attribute-transport module and re-exports the existing public function identity through SwAttrSet; color and item semantics are unchanged.
